text: Closing the ten 2014 stations (Clerkenwell, Westminster, Southwark, Belsize, Kingsland, Knightsbridge, Downham, Woolwich, Bow, Silvertown) raised London’s average response by 9.4 seconds and pushed 1,241 extra incidents past the 6‑minute mark. The hardest‑hit ward was Knightsbridge & Belgravia, where mean delay jumped 138 seconds and 14 of 160 incidents exceeded six minutes. Compared with the three 2014 postures, the actual closures resulted in 4,049 broken promises, the naïve “no‑change” plan would have caused 5,290, while the optimized alternative would have limited the harm to 2,762.
